title: Vero ingestion v1: create submission
description: For a sending system to check what it sends to POST /api/v1/ingestion/submissions. The same fields as CreateSubmissionRequest in sdv-ingestion-v1.openapi.json (the build checks that they agree). This schema refuses fields it doesn't list, so a sender finds them first; Vero itself ignores unknown fields, and refuses sensitivityLevel (SDV-SEN-006).

recordSensitivityLevel.description: Optional level for the whole record this submission belongs to. Exact names only. A delivery may raise a record's level, never lower it.
